sources.title: Run & Benchmark Qwen3.5 0.8B: Smallest Multimodal AI Model
sources.snippet: Quick answer. Qwen3.5 0.8B is Alibaba's smallest multimodal model, with a 262K context window and native vision support. Pull it with `ollama run qwen3.5:0.8b` for text or run the GGUF in llama.cpp for image input. Expect strong recall but weak code accuracy — bump to Qwen3.5 4B for any coding task.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B - VRAM, Specs & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: About Qwen3.5-0.8B Qwen3.5-0.8B is Alibaba Cloud's ultra-compact multimodal foundation model with 0.8B parameters, released February 2026. It uses a hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks and Gated Attention in a 6× (3×DeltaNet→FFN→1×Attention→FFN) pattern. In thinking mode, it achieves MMLU-Pro (66.5%), GPQA Diamond (51.6%), and GPQA (11.9%). Features unified vision ...
